name: subtitle
label: Subtitle / context line
default: Review and approve your team's monthly shift submissions

name: show_pay_amounts
label: Show pay amounts to managers
hint: When off, no monetary value is sent to the browser at all — managers see shift counts only. Enforced server-side, not just hidden in the template. Use where pay is confidential from line managers.

name: manager_field
label: Manager field on sys_user
hint: Field on sys_user holding the approving manager. Change only if your org routes approval by something other than the standard manager field.

name: enable_co_entitlement
label: Enable CO entitlement rules
hint: Must match the same option on the employee calendar widget. Governs whether a day correction applies the compensatory-off entitlement rules — whether CO is offered only inside an open window, and whether removing an OC shift a CO depends on is refused. The two screens disagreeing here is worse than either setting alone.

name: shift_table
label: Day-entry table
hint: Table name. Must have columns u_user, u_date, u_shift_type, u_comment.

name: lock_table
label: Monthly timesheet table
hint: Table name. Must have u_user, u_year, u_month, u_submitted_on plus the approval columns status, approver, actioned_on, manager_comment.

name: catalog_table
label: Shift catalogue table
hint: Table name. Active rows supply chip colours (color_hex), names and rates.

name: summary_table
label: Aggregate summary table
hint: Table name. Monthly rows (u_period_type = month) are the source of the shift mix and cost shown in the queue, including the rate snapshot.

name: audit_table
label: Day-change audit table
hint: Table name. One row per manager correction to a day: user, date, previous_shift, new_shift, reason, changed_by, changed_on.

name: entitlement_table
label: CO entitlement table
hint: Table name. Maps a compound-OC shift to the CO right it grants. Read and written when a day correction touches a shift whose oc_role grants or consumes a CO.
